handoff.salientSummary: Implemented the Reservation Book and Host Stand App UI and guards (`today.tsx`, `book.tsx`, `timeline.tsx`, `floor.tsx`, `calendar.tsx`, `overview.tsx`, `settings.sections.tsx`, `booking-sheet.tsx`, `walk-in-dialog.tsx`, `detail-sheet.tsx`, `conflict-panel.tsx`, `use-live-now.ts`, `use-reservations-poll.ts`, region-switch guard, and location-delete guard), translated all 309 new strings into Arabic (`ar.po`), and verified with Vitest, Playwright E2E (3 repeats), and agent-browser on US and KSA.
handoff.whatWasImplemented:
Implemented the complete Reservation Book and Host Stand App UI and control-plane guards in `apps/app`:
1. Region-Switch & Location-Delete Guards (`VAL-BOOK-028`..`VAL-BOOK-031`, `VAL-CROSS-001`, `VAL-CROSS-004`):
   - Created `RegionReservationsGuard` (`apps/app/app/components/reservations/region-reservations-guard.tsx`) and wired it into `site-card.tsx` and `website+/_index.tsx` so switching `dataRegion` displays regional reservation counts, requires typing the organization slug when counts > 0, blocks when unsettled payments exist (409), and fails closed (502/503) when the current regional `tenant-api` cannot be verified.
   - Added `fetchLocationReservationsSummary` and `checkLocationReservationsDeleteGuard` in `region-guard.server.ts` and wired them into `settings+/locations.$locationId.tsx` and `settings+/locations._index.tsx` to block deleting a location with active future reservations and notify regional `tenant-api` via `notifyReservationsContextChanged` when locations change.
2. Hooks & Browser-Direct API Layer (`VAL-BOOK-024`, `VAL-HOST-011`, `VAL-HOST-013`, `VAL-HOST-017`):
   - Created `useLiveNow` (`apps/app/app/hooks/use-live-now.ts`) for location-IANA-timezone business date and minute-of-day timers.
   - Created `useReservationsPoll` (`apps/app/app/hooks/use-reservations-poll.ts`) and `requestConditional` (`reservations-client.ts`) for `If-None-Match` ETag polling that preserves state references on `304 Not Modified` and pauses during drag/modal interactions.
   - Created `book-api.ts` (`apps/app/app/utils/reservations/book-api.ts`) normalizing all `/operator/reservations/book/*` responses and mutations.
3. Host Stand Shared Components & Routes (`VAL-BOOK-023`..`VAL-BOOK-038`, `VAL-HOST-001`..`VAL-HOST-028`, `VAL-CROSS-002`..`VAL-CROSS-006`):
   - Created `host-subnav.tsx`, `booking-sheet.tsx`, `walk-in-dialog.tsx`, `detail-sheet.tsx`, `conflict-panel.tsx`, and `use-host-stand.ts`.
   - Implemented `today.tsx`, `book.tsx`, `timeline.tsx` (15-min slot grid, cover pacing strip, unassigned lane, pointer & keyboard DnD with `aria-live`, duration resize, locked-bar Unlock prompt, 409 conflict banner, 10s ETag poll), `floor.tsx` (live 8-state table canvas with `dir="ltr"`, elapsed/remaining timer, section overlays, high-contrast mode, drag-to-seat and occupied Swap/Reflow/Overbook prompt, quick actions with course stage progression and 1-tap block, 5s ETag poll), `calendar.tsx`, `overview.tsx` (with per-service notes saved and displayed on `HostSubnav`), and `settings.sections.tsx`.
   - Updated `reservations-guards.test.ts` to assert all 16+ reservations routes, extracted and translated all 309 new Arabic strings in `apps/app/app/locales/ar.po`, and added comprehensive Vitest and Playwright E2E tests (`tests/e2e/reservations-host-stand.test.ts`).
